svg.text: Anime template: the parts a new character in the anime style starts from
Each part is the path whose id is its name. Edit a path to change the drawing; move or scale its group to tidy the sheet.
The small cross marks the part's origin. Hands are shown three times their size, mouths, limbs and shoes twice.

g.text: Hair variants: a cast picks one with `hair = "…"`. Each is drawn front-on and three-quarters; its parts are named `part@variant`.
